title: dryopteris laurentiorum
intro: Dryopteris laurentiorum, commonly known as Laurent's wood fern, is a species of fern in the Dryopteridaceae family. It is a perennial plant native to the island of Hispaniola, known for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its therapeutic actions as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and expectorant. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, contributing to its potential health benefits and therapeutic applications.
